notes.title: [1.1.0 Update] Significant Optimization to the Hint System
notes.content:
Dear players,
24 Solar Terms is about to celebrate its one-year anniversary, thank you all for your love and support. On the occasion of the first anniversary, we have significantly optimized the hint system and corrected some issues. Below, we bring you the update content of version 1.1.0:

[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where controller inputs may not work when harvesting crops in summer.
 Fixed an issue with item usage at the bonfire during the mosquito-repellent grass mission in autumn.
 Fixed an issue with collision boxes during the small snow insulation mission in winter, where items may not be properly received.
 Fixed crashes and possible skipping issues caused by controller inputs during scene loading.
 Fixed controller input issues that may occur when achievement pop-ups appear.


[Content Optimization]

 Significantly improved the hint system, allowing for precise item location hints in puzzle-solving sections. Update now and give it a try!
 Added a skip function to the ice sculpture mini-game.


The optimized hint system has removed a lot of text, and when searching for item clues, you only need to click on the silhouette of the item to accurately guide the camera to the location of the item, no longer needing to worry about unclear text descriptions (hints for non-item finding puzzles still remain text-based)!

Next, we will continue to fix bugs and optimize content. Thank you for your support and understanding. Have fun playing 24 Solar Terms and feel free to share your interesting stories while playing or exchange ideas and suggestions with other farmers. You are also welcome to provide feedback, and we will do our best to help you solve any problems.

notes.title: V1.07——Solar Terms Selection Function Added
notes.content:
Dear players,
Version 1.07 is now available with the addition of the [Solar Terms Selection] function. After the first playthrough, players can directly access any specified solar term task starting node. Please be sure to update!

Thank you for your support! We apologize for any bugs and issues that may have occurred before. Below are the details of this major update:

[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed the issue where players may get stuck offline in the Grain in Ear season.
 Fixed the issue where some mini-game storage data was incorrect.
 Fixed the issue where players were unable to place snowballs during the snowman building process.
 Fixed the issue where the upper left corner of the Sun Shooting mini-game and the compass button could be clicked through each other.
 Fixed the issue where the lantern in the Winter Beast mission was not lit.
 Fixed some issues that could cause the game to freeze.
 Fixed the issue where the achievement pop-up window could not be closed.
 Fixed some animation issues with certain plants.
 Fixed some sound effect errors.
 Fixed some layering errors.
 Fixed some animation errors with characters.
 Fixed the issue where the inventory may not refresh in a timely manner.
 Fixed the issue where player achievements and platform synchronization may be delayed or incorrect.
 Fixed the issue where the main menu may appear blurry.
 Fixed the issue where the mouse cursor may disappear in certain scenes.
 Fixed the issue where the right-click of the mouse in the Harvest mini-game may cause the game to freeze.


[Content Optimization]

 Optimized the position of the chicken coop and wild geese to prevent them from hiding behind the stakes.
 Optimized some text descriptions.
 Optimized some artistic resources for certain plants.
 Optimized the detection logic for the [Lucky Clover] achievement.
 Optimized some of the lighting after the end of the Great Cold season.
 Optimized the achievement pop-up window, which can now be opened by clicking it in-game.


[Function Additions]

 The [Solar Terms Selection] function is now available after the first playthrough. Players can find the [Solar Terms] button in the [Season Selection] panel of the main menu. This function can help players quickly reach the starting point of the target season task and is a great assistant for finding hidden items and achieving challenges.


With the addition of the [Solar Terms Selection] function, we have also updated the data saving logic for hidden items and side tasks. Once players have found a hidden item or completed a side task during the game, the data will be saved. Therefore, the [Solar Terms Selection] function will greatly help players find previously undiscovered hidden items and achieve their favorite achievements. Try it out after the update!

Next, we will continue to fix bugs and optimize content. Thank you for your support and understanding. We wish you a pleasant game experience and welcome you to share your interesting experiences and friendly exchanges with other players in the game and provide feedback on any issues you may encounter.

notes.title: [1.06 Major Update] Introduction of Hint System
notes.content:
Dear players,
The 1.06 version of the game is ready, and this time we have added a redesigned hint system, so you won't get stuck anymore. Please make sure to update your game!
Thanks for your enthusiasm! We apologize for any bugs and issues that appeared previously. Below we report the details of this major update:

[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed the issue where some levels in the free mode of the spot the difference game had oversized patterns.
 Fixed the issue where the canvas position for the tree leaf painting in the free mode was incorrect.
 Fixed the issue where the bubble of the farmer in the warm-up task disappeared too early.
 Fixed some sound effect issues.
 Fixed the issue where the hidden items in winter were incorrectly displayed.
 Fixed some classification and description errors in the collection.


[Content Optimization]

 Optimized the difficulty of the spot the wild vegetables game again, and now you can activate the skip function more quickly.
 Four additional achievements have been added in conjunction with the new hint system, one for each season (spring, summer, autumn, and winter). See details below.


[New Feature]

 Added a brand new hint system that covers almost all finding and puzzle quests in the main storyline. Moms don't have to worry about their kids getting stuck anymore.


Let me introduce the hint system to you:

 After version 1.06, most of the time in the game, the light bulb button of the hint system will be displayed in the upper right corner of the screen.
 After opening the panel, you can see how much time is left until the next hint. Each hint point contains one or two pieces of information, with a short time interval between the same hint points to give you time to try on your own; there is no time interval between different hint points.
 You can choose not to look at the hints, look at one hint, or look at all hints according to your own habits, to smoothly progress through the game.


Four additional challenge achievements have been added to the hint system, they are:

 Clear Spring Wind: Complete the Spring main quest with no more than 3 hints.
 Super Summer Sun: Complete the Summer main quest with no more than 3 hints.
 Pure Autumn Dew: Complete the Autumn main quest with no more than 3 hints.
 Bright Winter Ice: Complete the Winter main quest with no more than 3 hints.


To reward old players, all players who obtained the corresponding main quests achievement of each season before version 1.06 will automatically achieve the corresponding seasonal achievement after updating. For example, if a player successfully obtained the "Spring is Back" and "The Scorching Sun" achievements in the Spring and Summer main quests respectively in version 1.05, he will automatically achieve the "Clear Spring Wind" and "Super Summer Sun" achievements after updating to version 1.06. We hope everyone updates and login tolaims your achievements right away.

Next, we will continue to fix bugs and optimize content. Thank you for your support and understanding. Have fun playing "24 Solar Terms" and feel free to share your interesting stories while playing or exchange ideas and suggestions with other farmers. You are also welcome to provide feedback, and we will do our best to help you solve any problems.

notes.title: V1.05Update Info
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The 1.05 version update for the game is now available, and we hope that everyone will update!
First of all, thank you all for your enthusiasm, thank you everyone! At the same time, we apologize again for the various bugs that have appeared in the game, we're sorry! Below, we will report on version corrections, optimizations, and new features.

 [Bug Fixes]

 Fixed the issue where the token might get stuck when receiving it at the Spring Equinox in Spring.
 Fixed the issue where using the grain in advance could cause the game to get stuck in Summer.
 Fixed the issue where the camera could get stuck and players couldn't automatically correct it during the White Dragon event in Summer. Players who get stuck during the Little Heat White Dragon event must update.
 Fixed the problem of jittery multiple canvases in tree leaf painting open mode.
 Fixed the issue of incorrect lighting during summer nights.
 Fixed the issue where the bald teacher's bubble in the second stage of snakegrass could persist.
 Fixed some mini game error crashes in the main menu.
 Fixed some layering errors in some scenes.
 Fixed some sound effect errors.
 Fixed some character state machine errors.


 [Content Optimization] 

 Removed all open game bubbles in the scene to avoid misleading players.
 Optimized the description and collection classification of the fish scale stone item.
 Further optimized the difficulty of the sun shooting mini-game, now it's easier to activate the skip function.
 Optimized the parameters before the ice blocks are stationary in the ice block placement mini-game, they will now stop faster.


 [Function Addition] 

 In the Find Wild Vegetables mini-game, players can now skip it after attempting it for a while, so players who are stuck here can try it.
 Hidden items and side quest items now have silhouette hints and collection time reminders in the collection book, making it easier to find hidden items.
 Added a protective program for some user data storage errors that may occur.



In addition to bug fixes and content optimizations, we are redesigning the hint system to provide players with more guidance during the game. Thank you for your support and understanding.
Hope you have a good time in the game! Feel free to share your journey and conmunicate with other in the forum, thank you!

notes.title: V1.04 Update Info
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The 1.04 version update for the game is now available, and we hope that everyone will update!

First of all, we want to apologize to everyone. This is our first time releasing a paid game, and we will do our best to improve on our shortcomings. We sincerely apologize for any bugs and design issues in this version, and we bow to you ( Ĭ ^ Ĭ )!

After the game was released yesterday, we collected a lot of feedback through live streams, player recordings, instant messages, and comments. We are very grateful for this, and we have been working tirelessly to fix many issues overnight. Here are the corrections and optimizations:

[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where the camera near the Summer White Dragon could get stuck. (Players who got stuck here can now continue the game after updating, we are very sorry for this issue)
 Fixed an issue in Autumn where the Hammer worker could be used twice with the hammer, causing the game to freeze.
 Fixed an issue where the camera could appear abnormal when opening the Qiaoqiao task in Autumn.
 Fixed a layering error with Spring Flower Girl and Winter Rolling Pin.
 Fixed a data error when entering the game through the "Season Selection" level after completing the game.
 Fixed an issue where small games like "Finding Wild Vegetables" and "Drawing Tree Leaves" could crash.
 Fixed some minor layering issues.


[Content Optimizations]

 Significantly reduced the difficulty of the "Finding Different Colored Items" game in Spring. (We are very sorry for this and bow to you all)
 Optimized the random positions of the Spring Rake, Pruning Shears, and Seedlings, as well as the Summer Duck, Frog Mother, Seedlings, and Sickle, making them more noticeable. (Thank you for your hard work)
 Optimized the collision box for the Autumn Maternity and Cow Pen, making it easier to use items on them.
 Optimized the logic for obtaining the Fish Scale Stone item.
 Optimized the artistic resources for Seedlings and Reeds, making them more noticeable.
 Optimized the puzzle flow for the Summer Water Boiling and Autumn Roasting Duck locations, making their ideas consistent with other puzzles.
 Optimized the camera flow for the Wu Gang location, making it easier to provide guidance information.


[New Features]
 Added a "Skip" function for the "Finding Different Colored Items" game in Spring, the Summer Pipe Clearing, the Qin Puzzle, the Houyi Shooting Game, and the Winter Laba Bean Reading game. After a certain number of attempts, steps, or if players get stuck for a certain period of time, they can choose to skip the mini-game and continue the main story. (For those who are stuck, you can continue after updating!!)

Our team of three part-time workers has taken leave from their regular jobs to continue working hard to correct and optimize the game and ensure its quality. Thank you for your support and understanding.

Hope  you have a good time in the game! Feel free to share your journey and conmunicate with other in the forum, thank you!
